map.note: 12 territories in 3 regions (west, central, east), 4 each. All territories are supply centers. Each region wraps around: dawnspire-highlands provides a cycle. Coastal territories allow fleet placement.

order_box.note: Each player's secret orders during the diplomacy phase. Hidden from other players until resolution.

army.note: Land unit. Moves between adjacent territories. Can support adjacent units.

fleet.note: Naval unit. Can only occupy coastal territories. Can convoy armies across non-adjacent coastal territories.

supply_marker.note: Marks control of a supply center. Placed when a player occupies a supply center during the build phase.

phases.name: diplomacy
phases.note: All players secretly write orders for each of their units: hold, move, support, or convoy. Orders are hidden until the resolution phase.

phases.name: resolution
phases.note: All orders revealed simultaneously. Moves resolved by comparing strength: each move has base strength 1, plus 1 for each valid support. Equal strength = standoff (no movement). Successfully moved units occupy their destination; dislodged units must retreat.

phases.name: retreat
phases.ends_when: all dislodged units retreated or disbanded
phases.note: Dislodged units must retreat to an adjacent empty territory that was not the source of the attack, or be disbanded. If no valid retreat exists, unit is disbanded.

phases.name: build
phases.note: Players adjust unit count to match supply center count. If supply_centers > units, build new units on unoccupied home supply centers. If units > supply_centers, disband excess units.

order_types.definition: Each unit receives exactly one order: hold, move, support, or convoy
constraints: hold: unit stays in place with strength 1
move(destination): unit attempts to move to adjacent territory with strength 1
support(unit, destination): adds 1 to the supported unit's hold or move strength, if supporter is adjacent to destination
convoy(army, from, to): fleet in a sea/coastal territory transports an army between non-adjacent coastal territories

simultaneous_resolution.definition: All orders resolve simultaneously; no order has priority over another
simultaneous_resolution.constraint: order submission must be secret until all players have submitted

strength_calculation.definition: Move strength = 1 (base) + number of valid supports for that move
constraints: support is cut if the supporting unit is attacked from any direction except the one it is supporting toward
a unit supporting a move cannot be dislodged by the unit it is supporting

standoff.definition: When two or more units attempt to move to the same territory with equal strength, all fail (standoff)
standoff.effect: no unit moves; all remain in their original territories

dislodge.definition: A unit is dislodged when an attacking move has strictly greater strength than the defending hold/support strength
dislodge.effect: dislodged unit must retreat in the retreat phase

constraints: retreat destination must be adjacent to the unit's current territory
retreat destination must not be the territory from which the attack that dislodged the unit came
if no valid retreat exists, unit is disbanded

supply_center_control.definition: A player controls a supply center if they have a unit on it at the end of a fall turn
supply_center_control.effect: control persists until another player occupies it

build_rules.definition: After the fall turn, each player adjusts units to match supply center count
constraints: new units can only be built on home supply centers that are unoccupied
armies can be built on any home supply center
fleets can only be built on coastal home supply centers
if units > supply_centers, player must disband the excess

fleet_placement.definition: Fleets can only occupy coastal territories
fleet_placement.constraint: territory must have coastal=true in node_properties

end_conditions.condition: player controls 7 or more of 12 supply centers
end_conditions.name: majority_control

end_conditions.condition: all remaining players agree to draw
end_conditions.name: agreed_draw
